blocking_findings: P2U1-1 [Blocker] ux-browser: .tmp/model-guide-preview/real-work.html, the Print audit card, and harness/model-guide/preview.sh print_audit_block: at audited head 12e753b the block omits the bias note. It renders only the top-level scope note 'Seeded-error answer key of one unreleased book proof...'. The data file harness/model-guide/data/print-audit-2026-11.json holds summary.bias_note 'A Sonnet 5.5 session wrote the answer key, so the s55 score may be too high. Review A noted E35 for s55 is partial, not found (minors found 5, not 6).' The served page holds the string 'wrote the answer key' 0 times. Rationale: spec D17 'The page' requires the block to show the two results, the error types with their counts, and the bias note; test-strategy section 9.2 lists the bias note as required. Same id and same defect as P2U1-1 in measure/runs/model_guide/ux-browser-b4fba01.json; Red 2.16 exists and Green 2.17 (70ebfc5) fixed it, so no new routing is needed. Fix: render summary.bias_note in the block; the fix landed at 70ebfc5 and this run verified it in the served preview at e13413f.
nonblocking_findings: P2U1-2 [Nit] ux-browser: .tmp/model-guide-preview/index.html, the nav: no link carries aria-current. The active Overview link uses the class active only, while real-work.html keeps aria-current=page on its Real work link and no wrong link carries aria-current. Rationale: docs/index.html is pre-existing markup outside the Phase 2 diff, so this is no regression; the overview page still gives a screen reader no current-page marker. Same id as P2U1-2 in measure/runs/model_guide/ux-browser-b4fba01.json. Fix: add aria-current=page to the active Overview link.

Rationale: the boxes come from pre-existing docs/index.html outside the Phase 2 diff, while the new Model guide box carries tabindex 0, role region, and a name. Same id as P2U1-3 in measure/runs/model_guide/ux-browser-b4fba01.json. Fix: give the two boxes tabindex 0, role region, and an aria-label.

Same id as P2U1-4 in measure/runs/model_guide/ux-browser-b4fba01.json. Fix: confirm the row scope with the PM, or show a base line in every picked row.
